decontamination_notes: Real bug fix from labstack/echo PR #3049, merged 2026-07-21, after the training cutoffs of the models this suite targets; re-check upstream_merged against any newer model's cutoff before reusing. Group middleware registration implicitly adds RouteNotFound routes for the group prefix; under RouterConfig{AllowOverwritingRoute: false} a second Use (or Use after creating the group with middleware) panicked because the implicit routes could not be re-registered. The fix spans four files (system complexity): route.go adds an unexported allowOverwrite marker on Route, group.go sets it on the implicit registrations, and echo.go/router.go honor it in the add path so implicit bookkeeping routes are always replaceable while explicit user routes keep their overwrite protection. Repo sliced at the PR base commit (5a43c9b6): full module minus .git/.github with go mod vendor committed (upstream .gitignore vendor rule stripped; go-1.26 image for go.mod go 1.25). MIT LICENSE preserved. Hidden tests are behavioral (no new public API), in test-only sub-packages: vbgroup/ (fail_to_pass, 3 tests, each verified failing at base via the panic and passing after the gold patch) covers Use-twice, group-created-with-middleware plus later Use, and nested subgroups, all asserting both middlewares actually apply to a request; vbregg/ (pass_to_pass) guards explicit-route overwrite protection (recover-based, no message text), group middleware running on 404s inside the prefix, and group routing with params. Scoped to the upstream fix's contract: explicit RouteNotFound overriding the implicit one is NOT covered (the upstream change does not provide it).
